title: 第1章 苏醒第2章 钱可通神
slug: 符心护剑重建三十三重天
content_zh:
始源大陆，众神纪元年，贫瘠之地，启点镇。
清晨的薄雾尚未完全散去，笼罩着贫瘠之地特有的锈色天空。
高耸冰冷的钢铁城墙如同巨兽的脊背，蜿蜒横亘在启点镇的中心城区之外。
一个身影正沿着城墙外侧的宽阔步道匀速奔跑。
那是个约莫十五六岁的少年，身形瘦削却显得精干。
他穿着一套粗糙的亚麻布制成的长衣，样式简朴得如同地球上古罗马的农夫袍。
但脚上却蹬着一双与这身打扮格格不入的、颇具东方韵味的黑色布鞋，
活脱脱一个异世界混搭风。
汗水浸湿了他额前的黑发，汇聚成珠，顺着脸颊滑落。
在这清冷的早晨，他头顶甚至隐隐蒸腾着白色的热气，显是已经奔跑了极长的时间。
少年步伐沉稳，呼吸带着刻意调整的节奏，一路跑到南城门下。
守门的卫兵似乎对他早已熟悉，只是懒洋洋地抬了抬眼皮，便挥手示意他进去。
少年微微点头，算是回礼，脚步未停地穿过了厚重的金属门洞。
少年沿着主干道继续奔跑，最终在一栋约四层高、显得颇为气派的灰色建筑前放缓了脚步。
建筑大门上方，一块略显陈旧的金属牌匾上，刻着四个张扬的大字——和平饭店。
少年没有走向正门，而是熟练地拐进旁边的侧门。
门内是忙碌的厨房和后勤区域，空气中弥漫着食物和清洁剂混合的气味。
他一路小跑，不断有穿着饭店制服的员工和他打招呼。
“小苏，跑完步了？”
“嗯，张婶早。”

“哟，今儿也挺早啊，快去擦擦汗，别着凉。”
“知道啦，李叔。”
他的回应简短而迅速，脚步未停，沿着内部楼梯一路向上。
穿过走廊，最终推开一扇沉重的铁门，来到了饭店平坦的天台。
天台上视野豁然开朗，清凉的晨风立刻拂面而来，吹散了他周身蒸腾的热气。
少年径直走到天台边缘，双手撑在冰冷的护栏上，面向正东方。
远方，地平线上，一轮巨大的、橙红色的太阳正缓缓挣脱束缚，向上攀升。
然而，在这片苍茫的天空中，这并非唯一的光源，
他的头顶极高处，还悬挂着一轮散发着冷白光晕、体积稍小的白色太阳。
而在西边的天际，一弯残日轮廓模糊，正拖着黯淡的余晖，不甘地沉向地平线，它们诡异而又和谐地并存着。
三日凌空，这是始源大陆再平常不过的清晨景象。
然而，站在这片奇异天光之下的少年，心里却感受不到丝毫奇迹般的暖意。
只有一种浸入骨髓的冰冷和麻木。
三年多了。
苏醒这个前地球程序员，被裁后的道观居士，魂穿异世少年。
来到这个名为“始源大陆”
的异世界，已经整整三年多了。
content_en:
Origin Continent, Year of the Gods, Barren Land, Qidian Town.
The early morning mist has not completely dissipated, covering the Barrens' unique rust-colored sky.
The towering cold steel city wall is like the back of a giant beast, winding outside the central city of Qidian Town.
A figure was running at a steady speed along the wide footpath outside the city wall.
He was a young man of about fifteen or sixteen years old, with a slim but capable appearance.
He wore a long coat made of rough linen, as simple as the peasant robes of ancient Rome on Earth.
But on her feet was a pair of black cloth shoes with an oriental charm that were incompatible with this outfit.
It's like a mash-up style from another world.
Sweat soaked the black hair on his forehead, gathered into beads, and slid down his face.
In this cold morning, there was even a faint white heat steaming from the top of his head, indicating that he had been running for an extremely long time.
With a steady pace and a deliberately adjusted rhythm in his breathing, the young man ran all the way to the South City Gate.
The guard guarding the door seemed to be familiar with him. He just lazily raised his eyelids and waved for him to enter.
The young man nodded slightly in return, and walked through the thick metal door without stopping.
The boy continued running along the main road, and finally slowed down in front of a gray building about four stories high that looked quite impressive.
Above the door of the building, a slightly old metal plaque is engraved with four bold characters - Peace Hotel.
The young man did not go to the front door, but skillfully turned into the side door next to it.
Just inside the door is a busy kitchen and back-of-house area, and the smell of food and cleaning agents fills the air.
As he trotted along, employees in hotel uniforms kept saying hello to him.
"Xiao Su, are you done running?"
"Well, morning, Aunt Zhang."
"Hey, it's quite early today. Go wipe your sweat quickly and don't catch a cold."
"I know, Uncle Li."
His response was short and quick, and he continued walking up the inner stairs without stopping.
After walking through the corridor, he finally pushed open a heavy iron door and arrived at the flat rooftop of the hotel.
The view on the rooftop suddenly opened up, and the cool morning breeze immediately blew in his face, blowing away the steaming heat around his body.
The young man walked straight to the edge of the rooftop, placed his hands on the cold guardrail, and faced due east.
In the distance, on the horizon, a huge, orange-red sun is slowly breaking free from its restraints and climbing upwards.
However, this is not the only source of light in this vast sky.
Very high above his head, there was also a smaller white sun with a cold white halo hanging.
And in the western sky, the outline of a crescent sun is blurred, dragging its dim afterglow and sinking unwillingly toward the horizon. They coexist strangely and harmoniously.
Three days in the sky, this is an ordinary morning scene in the Origin Continent.
However, the young man standing under this strange skylight could not feel any miraculous warmth in his heart.
There is only a kind of coldness and numbness that penetrates the bone marrow.
More than three years.
Su Xing, a former Earth programmer, a Taoist layman after being laid off, and a young man whose soul has traveled to another world.
Come to this place called "Original Continent"
It has been more than three years since I entered this different world.
